1.1

A red word, a green one, blue and purple.

Gold, yellow, orange and highlight share a style.

Grey, gray, silver and muted share another.

Nested: bold red and underlined blue.

Unknown stays literal: [text]{.chartreuse}

Inline code is untouched: [text]{.red}

A link{.red} is not a span.

[in a fence]{.red}
